briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate multi-agent race as export controls tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate AGI timelines amid US-China chip tensions. US export controls slow Chinese progress while labs race on reasoning benchmarks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration. xAI Grok-3 and Google Gemini 3.1 push context windows past 2M tokens.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra ramp hits 500k units monthly. Microsoft and xAI announce 200k H100-equivalent cluster expansions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first multi-agent system to achieve autonomous R&D arrive before Q3 2027?
